messages:
bryan-ux: Dropping a quick sketch of the roles matrix with a new SSO-policy column. Asking for fast feedback on copy, keyboard nav, and audit deep-link behavior.

olivia-security: Main asks: explicit audit events on any SSO change, and a clear "managed at org level" label when applicable. Avoid small icons that can be missed in exported screenshots.

kevin-eng: Engineering note: show Effective SSO as a computed field in the API so UI and Audit can match. For deep-links, we'll support query params like ?role=xyz&events=sso_change,permission_change.

bryan-ux: Copy options for SSO badge: A) "SSO: Org managed" B) "SSO: Role override" — which reads best? Also thinking about short badges for compact mode: "Org" / "Override" with aria-labels.

tia-pm: Prefer full wording in expanded view and short in compact. Product leans toward preventing accidental overrides, so make overrides open a confirmation modal.

olivia-security: Confirmation modal must include number of affected users and require a checkbox for admin-level changes. Also log prior_value in audit.

kevin-eng: Keyboard nav: Enter opens role detail panel, Escape closes, Arrow keys navigate rows. If the panel is open, focus should be trapped inside. We'll implement focus-return on close.

bryan-ux: I'll add prefers-reduced-motion handling and explicit focus outlines. Also ensure badges don't rely on color. Added example aria-label: "SSO status: Organization managed".

tia-pm: On audit nav, prefill filters and set a short time window (30 days) by default to avoid heavy queries. Provide a "load more" to expand timeframe.

olivia-security: Good. Also require that audit deep-links include actor= and reason= when actions are triggered from UI modals.

access-bot: Reminder: accessibility review scheduled Fri 11am PT.

bryan-ux: Decision check: modal override for per-role SSO? If no objections we'll go modal.

kevin-eng: Modal is fine. Adds safer server-side validation.

tia-pm: Modal override: +1.

olivia-security: Modal override: +1.

bryan-ux: Thanks all 609 I'll update the comp with SSO column, confirm modal copy, and the audit deep-link pattern. Will ping when ready for final pass.
